item.title: Has electricity decoupled from natural gas prices in Germany?
item.description:
📝 That means electricity prices are structurally linked to gas prices — when gas rises, electricity rises with it. Data sources: Electricity prices from Fraunhofer ISE energy-charts. TTF gas annual averages from ICE/IEA.
🔗 Read more: https://has-electricity-decoupled-yet.strommarktberatung.de
